name: folder-debouncer
description: Rebuild when you say so: hold back autosaved edits from ng serve, tsc --watch and other watchers until you flush. macOS.
author: Astervista

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:watcher
scripts.build:watcher: clang -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=10.15 -framework CoreServices -o watcher/watcher watcher/watcher.c
scripts.example: npm run build && node dist/index.js example/debouncer.json
